issues.on_page: Community Development 11,725 (Keno Fund 10,000, assigned for Community Betterment p3; Housing Rehabilitation 1,725)
issues.issue: The FY2024 extraction puts the same statement line in Community Betterment. The Keno Fund part (10,000, 85%) is community betterment money, so the year-to-year categories don't match.

issues.on_page: CAPITAL CONTRIBUTIONS 12,852 (Water); Statement of Activities p2 capital grants and contributions; budget schedule p11 'Federal' 12,852
issues.issue: The capital contribution (a federal capital grant) is recorded as other_financing rather than as a business-type receipt (federal grants). It is defensible because it is printed below income before contributions.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 1,050 (all Cemetery department, p12)
issues.issue: The same 1,050 is Cemetery Fees in detail (detail[32]) but charges for services/fees in receipts. The same label gets different categories within the report.
Lease of the electric system to the public power district is put in Rentals. This is a judgment call; it is consistent with FY2024.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 656,054 + cash held by county treasurer 2,401 (no single printed cash total)
issues.issue: Cash is a sum the extractor computed (marked computed, arithmetic correct), as is beginning_cash 475,553 = 473,349 + 2,204. Under the 2026-11-06 ruling cash is filled only where printed. Please confirm a sum of printed cash lines is acceptable.
